fdk_reconstruct — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• 데이터 종류: projstack × ctgeometry → voxel

• 호출: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fdk_reconstruct(projections, geometry, filter_name='ramp', cutoff=1.0, device='auto', allow_incomplete=False)(구현을 직접 호출하려면 import ctscan; ctscan.fdk_reconstruct(projections, geometry, filter_name='ramp', cutoff=1.0, device='auto', allow_incomplete=False), 원장에서 가져오려면 opstomography.get("fdk_reconstruct"))

• GPU: 없음(CPU 참조 구현만)

사용법

재구성 공식이 있는 모든 스캔의 필터 역투영: FDK와 그 계열.

> 아래 상세 설명은 원문입니다 —— 요약과 제목은 번역되어 있습니다.

The Feldkamp-Davis-Kress steps, on one code path: weight each sample by the cosine of its ray and by the scan's redundancy, ramp-filter along the detector rows, then back-project with the (DSO / U)^2 weight. A fan is one row, a short scan takes Parker's weight, an offset detector Wang's, a helix a row window normalised per voxel, laminography a sin(tilt) scale, and a parallel beam has no divergence weight. The equiangular detector takes the (gamma / sin gamma)^2 kernel.

A scan with no formula, or an arc too short to determine the object, is refused and named: use sirt_reconstruct or tv_reconstruct.

:param projections: (view, V, U) line integrals. :param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param filter_name: one of tomography.FILTERS except "none". :param cutoff: fraction of Nyquist to keep, (0, 1]. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :param allow_incomplete: reconstruct an arc under the minimum anyway. The result

is missing a wedge of the object and the density reads low.

:returns: (Z, Y, X) float attenuation volume. :raises ValueError: on a shape that disagrees with the geometry, a tomosynthesis

scan, or an incomplete arc. Empty input (projections with 0 elements) raises

ValueError.
